question: What is the name of the political party announced by Elon Musk?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**America Party**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Elon Musk announces new political party ‘America Party’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Elon Musk** has announced a new **political party** in the US called the **America Party**.

 
 
• 
 
The party aims to **challenge** the **two-party system** (currently dominated by **Republicans** and **Democrats**).

 
 
• 
 
Musk is **ineligible to run for president** because he was **born outside the US**.

 
 
• 
 
Musk **has not revealed** who will **lead the America Party**.

 
 
• 
 
It is still **unclear** if the party is **officially registered** with **US election authorities**.
